features.title: Smarter, faster answers with the right visuals
features.script: The assistant now runs on an upgraded model, so you get answers that are faster and more consistent than before. When you ask a question, a new adapter automatically picks the right way to show your data — whether that's a chart, a KPI card, or a table. You don't need to do anything differently; it just works better.
bullets: Auto-selects the right chart, card, or table

features.title: Export Reports to PDF, Word, or PowerPoint
features.script: You can now export any report or dashboard view to a polished, shareable document in one click. Head to the report toolbar, choose your format — PDF, Word, or PowerPoint — and download it straight away. Your charts and tables come through exactly as you see them on screen.
bullets: Export to PDF, Word, or PowerPoint
One click from the report toolbar
Works on any report or dashboard

features.title: Turn Any Report Into a Narrated Video
features.script: You can now turn any report into a short narrated video, complete with an AI voiceover. Just open the video reports tray and generate one straight from there. In fact, this panel you're watching right now was made exactly the same way.
